notes.title: I'm working on a new game! Saddle Up and Drive, take a look!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm working on a new project, in a totally different genre. My new game is called Saddle Up and Drive; it's a top-down driving game set in the '70s. The gameplay focuses on earning money every day to pay the mortgage on your farm and to buy new cars. There are various missions available, such as smuggling, truck driving, firefighting, ambulance driving, and bounty hunting. If you are interested in testing it, you can subscribe to the Beta now. It will be available for free on the 27th and 28th of April!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451620/Saddle_Up_and_Drive/

notes.title: November 2023 Patch
notes.notes:
Content of this patch for Upirja (V1023):
- enlarged field of view
- switch on/off option for acting voices (in instructions/options main menu)
- faster walking/running speed
- shotgun improvements: zoom when the player aims + buckshot ammo
- character text inside colored comics balloons
- some minor bugs resolved

notes.title: New mini game 'Revenge' released!
notes.notes: Upirja has finally a new mini game, the Revenge of Mirna!

notes.title: New minigame in progress
notes.notes:
The new minigame in which you will play as the vampire is almost completed.
I have introduced into the game a soldier squad who will hunt down Mirna.
You will have to avoid this patrol and kill all the villagers wandering in the woods looking for wood. Your vitality will depend on how much blood you can drink from your victims. Bon appetite!

notes.title: New minigame under development!!!
notes.notes:
News coming soon!!! I'm working on a new minigame for Upirja! 
This time you can be the vampire! You'll have to chase the villagers into the woods and bleed them.

Gameplay & features in project:
- third person view of Mirna
- blood reserve, for quick attack
- the villagers only see in front of them, the attack can be done only ambushing them
- when your preys see you, they will run to safety in the village 
- new map

I will need about one / two months to complete and test this new minigame, stay tuned!
If you have any suggestions, please let me know in comments!

notes.title: New patch for last chapter and Revenants game
notes.notes:
Here the list of the improvements released:

1) in the last chapter, there is a checkpoint before to kill Mirna
2) solved some bugs on Mirna behaviour in the final battle
3) in the Revenants minigame now there are the following new features:
- three difficulty levels: easy, hard and impossible (100, 200 or 300 revenants to be killed)
- when your health is under 50 lifepoints, for each vampire you hit, you will earn one lifepoint
- there are red crosses that gives you 100% health
- new weapon! You can pick up some wood logs to throw them against the revenants, just change your weapon by right mouse button click

notes.title: New game features
notes.notes:
New features for the game in next patch!

I am working on a new game update that includes the following new features:
1) in the last chapter, after the exorcism, a checkpoint will be introduced, so that if you fail to defeat Mirna, you won´t have to repeat the whole level from the beginning.
2) In the Revenants minigame, there will be a chance to heal yourself, making the game less hard
This patch will be released in about one week.

notes.title: Bugs fixed and improvements
notes.notes:
We fixed the following bugs/issues:
- improved the field of view of the camera
- fixed the bug when talk to the priest in the first chapter (locked player)
- in the third chapter, the wolves don't jump in the snow everytime, the number of animals is increased
- in the third chapter, improved the shotgun precision 
- in the instruction menu, there is the possibility to play the chapter you want, if you love zapping
